subject: english
question: Identify the appropriate fact from the passage.

options.text: Residents have started using makeshift Xandersol filters

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• From the passage,** it is mentioned** that "In desperation, residents have resorted to fitting out their taps with makeshift Xandersol filters."
 
• This** statement provides** the fact that residents, concerned about the contamination of the drinking water with Xandersol, have taken action by installing makeshift filters to safeguard their drinking water.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Residents have started using makeshift Xandersol filters'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"The culprit is punished" **- The passage does not provide any information about the punishment of the culprit responsible for the Xandersol contamination.
 
• **"Residents are fleeing the town" **- There is no mention or indication in the passage that residents are leaving or fleeing the town due to the Xandersol contamination.
 
• **"Pharmaceutical companies are closed" **- The passage does not mention anything about the closure of pharmaceutical companies.
